meta.description: Process and analyze single-cell ATAC-seq data with Signac, ArchR, SnapATAC2, or Cell Ranger ATAC. Use when handling 10X scATAC or 10X Multiome (paired RNA+ATAC) data, performing per-cell QC, choosing between ArchR/Signac/SnapATAC2 ecosystems, building per-cluster consensus peaksets, integrating with paired scRNA-seq, doublet detection (AMULET vs ArchR vs scDblFinder), or running pseudobulk differential accessibility per cluster.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; checked figures (XIST coordinates, LSI1-depth correlation, cell-calling leniency) are traceable; uncited numbers noted in SCATAC-008 and SCATAC-014

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics Skill with no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: dims 2:30 rationale confirmed on real data; the ScaleData cell-cycle remedy and AMULET-primary default are flawed (SCATAC-007, SCATAC-008) but are guidance errors, not a principled fallacy in a produced result

code_usability.detail: The primary shipped script scripts/signac_workflow.R does not run on its documented input (annotation genome mismatch, SCATAC-001); reproduced in two independent runs; one-line class of fix, but the script is not runnable as shipped

functional_suitability.note: Broad ecosystem coverage and routing; primary script fails as shipped, SnapATAC2 block fails twice, cell-cycle fix ineffective

reliability.note: Script has no annotation/input guard; ArchR returns empty quietly; scDblFinder/AMULET/macs3 edge behaviour undocumented

performance_context.note: SKILL.md about 10 KB with one-level routed references; QC and doublet tables are dense but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear ecosystem decision table and failure modes; QC rule set contradictory across files; AMULET without a command

human_usability.note: Good trigger description and example requests; error recovery advice limited

security.note: No credentials or destructive operations; script writes to CWD with a default prefix; upstream downloads unchecksummed

maintainability.note: License and provenance preserved, versions verified current; unpinned, no numpy/AMULET env note

agent_specific.note: Trigger-rich description; scientific rationale for dims 2:30 verified; several uncited numbers and overstated defaults

key_strengths: Strong ecosystem-choice guidance and failure-mode table; the LSI dims 2:30 rationale reproduces on real Multiome data
Most workflows execute end to end on real public PBMC data once documented gaps are patched: WNN, ArchR, Signac CallPeaks, scDblFinder, AMULET fragment route, PEAKVI mapping
Version claims are current (Signac 1.17.1, Seurat 5.5.1, ArchR 1.0.3, SnapATAC2 2.10.0 with import_fragments); XIST coordinates verified; cell-calling leniency confirmed on real singlecell.csv
Clean progressive disclosure with one-level routed references; MIT license and provenance preserved

recommendations.title: Shipped signac_workflow.R fails on annotation genome
recommendations.problem: The primary script aborts with 'Annotation genome does not match genome of the object' on its documented input and writes nothing.
recommendations.root_cause: EnsDb annotation is Ensembl-style with no genome while the object is hg38/UCSC.
recommendations.fix: Convert annotation with seqlevelsStyle(ann) <- 'UCSC' and genome(ann) <- 'hg38' before CreateChromatinAssay and rerun end to end (SCATAC-001).

recommendations.title: SnapATAC2 block errors twice on 2.10.0
recommendations.problem: data.obs['sample_id']='rep1' raises and tl.leiden fails with 'No such key: distances'; default macs3 parallelism fails in plain scripts.
recommendations.root_cause: Block was not executed against the current SnapATAC2 API.
recommendations.fix: Use a list assignment or drop the line, add snap.pp.knn before leiden, and use n_jobs=1 or a main guard for macs3 (SCATAC-002, SCATAC-003, SCATAC-011).

recommendations.title: Contradictory QC thresholds across files
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md table, script and usage guide use different metrics and bands; the script omits mito and doublet steps the workflow requires.
recommendations.root_cause: Thresholds merged from sources without one canonical rule set.
recommendations.fix: Define one rule set, implement or explicitly exclude each row in the script, and align examples (SCATAC-004).

recommendations.title: AMULET route: no command, numpy pin, depth default
recommendations.problem: No AMULET command or numpy<1.24 requirement is given, and AMULET is ranked primary although most cells in the demo data are below its recall depth.
recommendations.root_cause: Defers to upstream and states ranking without the depth condition.
recommendations.fix: Add the AMULET.sh recipe and env pin, make tool choice depth-conditional, and source the depth threshold (SCATAC-005, SCATAC-008).

recommendations.title: Cell-cycle regression and WNN snippets not executable
recommendations.problem: ScaleData on the ChromatinAssay errors and would not affect RunSVD; the WNN block needs magrittr.
recommendations.root_cause: RNA idioms and implicit package attachments were carried over untested.
recommendations.fix: Replace the regression method with one that acts on LSI and test it; attach magrittr or avoid pipes (SCATAC-006, SCATAC-007).

recommendations.title: Prerequisites, guards and uncited claims
recommendations.problem: Install list misses leidenbase/magrittr/macs3, ArchR and PEAKVI lack input guards, several quantitative claims are uncited, and singlecell.csv columns are unverified beyond Cell Ranger ATAC 1.0.1.
recommendations.root_cause: Prerequisites and claims were not derived from executed code paths.
recommendations.fix: Complete the prerequisites, add the ArrowFiles and peak-set checks, cite or soften numbers, and test cellranger-arc metadata when 10x access exists (SCATAC-009, SCATAC-010, SCATAC-012, SCATAC-013, SCATAC-014, SCATAC-015).
